cases.title: Turn any YouTube video into shorts with Vreato

skeleton.brief: Introduce the problem of cutting long podcasts into clips quickly
Long videos need quick clipping for social media posts
Introduce Vreato as the solution for clipping videos
Start on the dashboard and press New Project
Pick a template that decides the output style
Paste the YouTube link to import transcript automatically
Choose number of clips, default is four for forty minutes
Open settings panel to set aspect ratio and caption style
Press Generate and watch progress bar process the video
View clips in switcher and play each with synced captions
Each clip includes YouTube kit with title, description, chapters
One link in, four ready-to-post clips out

narration.text: You have a forty minute podcast and no time to cut it into clips.

slot_stat.heading: 40-minute podcast
bullets: No time to create clips quickly

narration.text: Long videos need quick clipping for social media posts. Manually cutting takes hours and slows down content sharing.
Vreato is the solution that clips long videos automatically, saving you time and effort.
